## Originating Issue
Link the commissioned Issue and state the outcome or partial progress.

## Semantic fidelity and assumptions
Explain how definitions, hypotheses, and conclusions correspond to the informal intent. Flag vacuity, new dependencies, trusted-base assumptions, and approved scope changes.

## Verification
Record the base commit, pinned toolchain, exact commands, results, and proof-integrity audit. Include failures and evidence relevant to review.

## Limitations and review
State unresolved goals, unverified behavior, and decisions for the independent reviewer. Link evidence and follow-up issues where available.
